item.title: v4.23118.1
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.321.

General

  • Changed how Claude Code finds the programs it starts itself on Windows, such as git: it no longer finds them through network (UNC) or relative PATH entries, or behind a link to a network share. Where Git is found only that way, sessions use PowerShell instead of Git Bash.
  • Changed the certificate that signs Claude Code on macOS to a newer Developer ID certificate of the same Anthropic team (Team ID Q6L2SF6YDW). Rules that match the Team ID are unaffected; rules that pin the certificate itself need the new certificate added beside the old one.
  • Fixed replies stopping with "API Error: EPROTO: The TLS handshake failed" when the connection broke partway through a reply. Claude now keeps what arrived and continues.

Code

  • Changed skills in a subfolder's .claude/skills folder to no longer load during a session when Claude Code's sandbox is on. To use them, start the session in that subfolder.
  • Fixed Bash commands sometimes running in the wrong folder when Claude sent several at once and an earlier one changed folders.
  • Fixed the project's skills, commands and agents that a worktree lacks, such as files git does not track, disappearing from the menu after Claude entered that worktree. While there, the main project folder's copies are listed and run.

Cowork

  • Fixed a task or chat showing "Claude Code crashed" at the next message when its saved state file was cut short.

3P

  • Changed fable in inferenceModels to request the newest Fable model, unless your gateway's /v1/models has an ID fable or a model tagged Fable. Requests can fail if that model isn't served. To pick one, keep fable and add an entry with its exact ID and anthropicFamilyTier set to fable.
  • Changed tool calls made by a plugin's own code (a mod), rather than by Claude, to never show an approval card. They now run where only the user's approval or Auto mode would have stopped them, including connector tools with no toolPolicy entry. Such calls to a tool set to ask are refused.
  • Fixed Cowork's Progress panel not ticking steps that a subagent marked done.

item.title: v4.23118.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.317.

General

  • Changed the organization setting that blocks other accounts on a computer: once a member has signed in there, the Claude API key and Console sign-in and the computer's own third-party setup are unavailable too while the block lasts.
  • Fixed a new chat's saved draft being deleted when only spaces or blank lines were typed before the draft had loaded.
  • Fixed connections failing with a certificate error on computers whose company root certificate was renewed with a new key.
  • Fixed Enter or Tab in the "/" menu running a command you had not chosen, or sending your half-typed text, when more commands finished loading.
  • Fixed losing the saved sign-in when a company proxy or firewall answered its renewal with a block page.
  • Fixed permission and question cards and the "Paused" and "Switched to" notices being cut off, with some buttons out of reach or running out of the card, at 400% zoom or in very short or narrow windows, and the "Switched to" notice not closing there.
  • Fixed the third-party history import, the Code tab's queued message and task list, and several saved app files not being read on Windows when the user profile lives in an FSLogix profile container.

Code

  • Added a Minimize button to the Terminal, Browser, and iOS Simulator panes. A minimized pane stays as a small live view in a corner of the chat, or in the session rail when it's shown. You can expand it again or close it, and in a corner you can also move and resize it (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed SSH sessions to hold a message that has waited over a day for its host: it stays above the message box until you press Send now.
  • Improved reconnecting SSH sessions through a slow proxy command or jump host on Mac and Linux: your message or Retry now waits up to 90 seconds, unless the SSH config sets ConnectTimeout.
  • Improved SSH sessions on hosts that ask you to sign in at every connection: they can now ride out longer network gaps without a new sign-in.
  • Fixed SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR in Claude Code's managed settings being overridden in Code sessions when the same variable is set on the computer.
  • Fixed a Windows issue where quitting during a settings save could leave ~/.claude.json empty.
  • Fixed attached files sometimes failing to upload when the network connection changed during the upload.
  • Fixed Claude being unable to read the files of plugins turned on in the managed-settings file when allowed workspace folders are set, for organizations with no server-managed settings.
  • Fixed HTML previews in SSH and WSL sessions showing empty charts and tables that the page's own scripts draw. Organizations that set disableBrowserExternalNavigation in Claude Code's managed-settings.json keep scripts off in these previews.
  • Fixed SSH sessions failing to start: "Couldn't start the remote server" on hosts whose home folder is on a slow network drive, and Claude Code start failures on Windows hosts that are not set to English, where low memory and similar causes are now retried and shown with their own message.
  • Fixed SSH sessions losing background work on the host after your Claude account's sign-in ran out while the app was away.
  • Fixed SSH sessions not reconnecting by themselves after the network drops during a sign-in (with a saved password: one more try while you are at the computer, and one about 30 minutes later if nobody is; Mac and Linux) or after a long outage when the host's firewall limits new connections.
  • Fixed the app reconnecting over and over, signing in each time, to an SSH host whose shell start-up files print text or change HOME, now saying what to fix at the first refusal, and SSH sign-in questions from an earlier jump host getting lost when a later jump host shares connections.

Cowork

  • Fixed a comment on a file seeming to send from a read-only task. It is now saved on the file.
  • Fixed Cowork deletions left unsent on the few Windows PCs where an October update moved the app's data folder only part way.
  • Fixed imported tasks sometimes starting without your organization's allowed domains when the app was slow to start.
  • Fixed imported tasks using Memory after your admin or you turned Memory off.
  • Fixed new cloud tasks requesting a model that isn't available to you.
  • Fixed removing an import from Settings > Import leaving behind a task whose saved record could not be read.
  • Fixed the app closing, reopening and setting up Claude's workspace again when the workspace could not download or set up its copy of Claude Code.

3P

  • Added "Apps gateway admin" to the user menu, where a Claude apps gateway's spend admins set spend limits and pooled budgets, see spend, and export spend by group and the log of spend limit changes. It shows where people use the gateway's own sign-in and bootstrapUrl is on the gateway's address.
  • Added claudeCodeProcessWrapperEnabled: starts Code sessions through the processWrapper launcher in Claude Code's managed settings, on the device or the SSH host. The launcher must supply the inference credential. Not used for sessions that run on Windows, in WSL or in Cowork.
  • Added disableDesktopLocalSessions: turns off Code sessions that run on the device, WSL included, so Code offers only remote environments such as SSH. Set sshHostAllowlist too.
  • Added disableWslSessions (MDM profile only): blocks Code sessions inside WSL. Unset, they stay blocked on managed devices, and only a machine-wide false allows them.
  • Added sshConfigs (beta): SSH connections offered to everyone in Code's environment menu. Every connection is still checked against sshHostAllowlist.
  • Added a "JSON config (redacted)" export to Setup on managed devices, for importing into the Admin Console. The values of API key, token and header settings are masked. Check URLs, arguments and text fields before sharing it.
  • Added a "Your usage limits" card to Settings > Usage that shows your session and weekly usage limits, where you sign in to a gateway in the app and it reports them. Spend limits do not show there.
  • Added a confirmation before you add, upload or turn on a plugin that your organization didn't provide.
  • Added a dismissible in-app notice, where a device profile sets forceLoginOrgUUID, that the saved Claude Console sign-in will stop working after a future update because its organization is not on the list. It shows the organization's ID to add.
  • Added memory to scheduled Cowork tasks that are not in a project: when memory is on, they can read what Cowork remembers but do not save new memories.
  • Added sign-in for a plugin's own connector in Cowork and Chat. One sign-in serves all your tasks, chats and scheduled tasks.
  • (breaking) Removed organizationPluginsUrl. Plugins it installed no longer load, even where the key is still set. Offer any you still need through allowedPluginMarketplaces.
  • Changed claudeAiImport.enabled: Import now also brings projects, memory, scheduled tasks, saved skills, uploaded plugins and some preferences from a Claude Desktop export that the user confirms is their own. Memory and preferences apply at once. Tasks, plugins and skills arrive turned off.
  • Changed claudeAiImport.exportEnabled: an export now also holds attached files, projects and their files, memory, scheduled tasks, saved skills, uploaded plugins, some preferences and local MCP servers. Passwords or API keys in them are included. Sign-ins and the servers' variable values are not.
  • Changed disableNonessentialServices to also stop the Code tab from reading the status of GitLab merge requests and Gerrit changes. GitHub is not affected.
  • Changed Chat and Cowork on macOS and Linux to ignore cross-certificates between old and renewed private root CAs. If a gateway's or proxy's issuing CA names one by serial number, requests can fail with a certificate error. Put both roots and that CA in the certificate store, then restart Claude.
  • Changed Cowork and Chat so the line that shows what Claude is doing reads "Needs your input" while a task waits for you, and "Nothing new from Claude for 2 minutes", counting up, once Claude has sent nothing for two minutes while no tool is running.
  • Changed Cowork and Chat to stay at your sent message while a long reply appears. To follow the reply, scroll to the end or press the round button above the message box.
  • Changed downloaded updates on macOS and Windows to install sooner: Claude restarts by itself after ten minutes with no Claude window in use and no task running. disableAutoUpdates still turns updates off.
  • Changed HTML previews in SSH and WSL sessions to run the page's inline scripts. To keep them off, set disableBrowserExternalNavigation in Claude Code's managed settings (it also limits the Browser pane to localhost). In a new file, add parentSettingsBehavior: "merge" to keep Desktop's policy.
  • Changed local Code sessions on macOS and Linux: where an organization's configuration sets allowedWorkspaceFolders, or leaves coworkEgressAllowedHosts unset or without *, Claude can still read Terminal panel tabs but no longer opens or types in them. Your own use of the panel is unchanged.
  • Changed profiles exported from Setup with Deployment mode set to Third-party only to also set disableDeploymentModeChooser, so that earlier versions hide Claude.ai sign-in too.
  • Fixed /etc/claude-desktop/managed-settings.json on Linux refusing the unredacted JSON config that Setup's Export menu writes. Earlier versions still refuse it.
  • Fixed live artifacts that failed on a connector tool nobody had approved, with nothing to click. The artifact now asks the person to allow the tool.
  • Fixed Settings > Import & export asking for an app update, with no way to sign in or choose a file, on computers with an older Claude Code. Import now downloads the Claude Code it needs.
  • Fixed the built-in GitHub connector's tools failing behind a proxy. They now follow egressProxyPacUrl, egressProxyUrl or the system proxy. For a ghe.com tenant, also allow api.<tenant>.ghe.com.
  • Fixed uploaded plugins working only in the tab they were uploaded from, or missing on MSIX installs below Windows 11 and where the app's data folder is reached through a link. Upload earlier ones again, choosing Replace if asked, to use them in every tab.
  • Fixed what you see at a Claude apps gateway's spend limit or group budget: the Code tab shows the gateway's own message instead of rate-limit errors, notices no longer offer a plan upgrade, and the "Billing issue" banner is hidden while those notices show.

item.title: v4.16336.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.317.

General

  • Changed sessions to ignore cross-certificates between old and renewed private root CAs in the certificate store. If a proxy's or gateway's issuing CA names one by serial number (Authority Key Identifier), requests can fail with UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY. Add that issuing CA to the store.
  • Deprecated fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026, after which fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8.
  • Removed claude.ai from the sites the built-in browser can import cookies for from another browser. If you imported claude.ai before, you are signed out of it in the built-in browser at the next launch.
  • Removed the tools that let Claude list and start shortcuts saved in the Claude in Chrome extension.
  • Fixed Claude on Windows staying open with no window after Windows declines an update.
  • Fixed dictated words being lost: Quick Entry dictation on Mac could close without adding what you said, and words still arriving in one message box could be discarded when a message was sent from another box on the same page.
  • Fixed files chosen in the message box being added after the signed-in account changed.
  • Fixed scheduled tasks failing silently: Claude now notifies you when a run couldn't use a connector that needs reconnecting, and when a run can't start.
  • Fixed the app coming back hidden or behind other apps, or the Dock icon on macOS showing no window, when the app was opened again (from its Dock icon, a link, a file, or a tray or menu bar item) while it was restarting to install an update or restarting on its own.
  • Fixed the Windows installer closing Claude and then failing on computers where an organization's policy blocks apps from outside the Microsoft Store, and leaving Claude closed when an installation fails after it has closed the running app.

Code

  • Changed worktree sessions: Claude Desktop no longer runs git's post-checkout hook when it makes a worktree; Claude Code's own worktrees run none either. pre-commit and other hooks still run for commits there. To copy ignored files like .env into new worktrees, list them in .worktreeinclude.
  • Removed the Windows fallback that read Claude Code's managed-settings.json from C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode. Keep the file in C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode, the only folder that Claude Code itself reads.
  • Fixed "Trust new key" failing for SSH hosts on Windows virtual desktops that use FSLogix or similar profile containers.
  • Fixed desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays (in Claude Code's settings) not deleting old transcripts of sessions still in the sidebar. Claude Code's cleanup now deletes them at the age its settings give, and they can't be restored.
  • Fixed a missing warning in SSH sessions when a sandbox that an organization's managed settings turn on can't start on the remote machine.
  • Fixed messages to SSH sessions being lost or stuck with no notice when the connection dropped or Claude Code couldn't start on the host, after the host was rebuilt, or after signing in on the New session page when the first try couldn't connect; they now send, retry, or return to the message box.
  • Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some sessions.
  • Fixed SSH reconnects on Windows setting off a jump host's phone push at every retry with nobody at the computer.
  • Fixed SSH sessions left running overnight stopping with a sign-in error, after Remote Control was denied for the account or after an unrelated crash whose message mentioned "401" or "unauthorized".
  • Fixed the previous account's sessions showing in the list after an account change that keeps the page open.

Cowork

  • Changed HTML and SVG file previews: alert, confirm and print dialogs are removed, including from buttons you click in the page; a page can start a download only shortly after you click in it; and a hung preview no longer stays on screen under the next file's name or keeps running after it closes.
  • Changed Reset App Data to also delete the signed-in account's Cowork tasks from Anthropic servers before it resets, where its confirmation dialog says so. Help > Troubleshooting > Delete Cowork VM Sessions and Restart is now named Delete Cowork Data and Restart.
  • Fixed a case where resetting memory could clear another signed-in account's local Cowork memories if the account changed during the reset.
  • Fixed buttons such as Deny being cut off or out of view on the web fetch, scheduled task, computer use and workflow permission cards in a small or zoomed window.
  • Fixed files added while creating a project from an existing folder emptying or replacing a file already in that folder.
  • Fixed some links in Claude's replies to files on a Windows computer not opening.
  • Fixed the app reinstalling the Cowork workspace (and, on a stop, quitting and relaunching) when the workspace was stopped or Claude was quit while it was still starting, for example by signing out or choosing Help > Troubleshooting > Delete Cowork Data and Restart.
  • Fixed the notice shown when a network blocks, interrupts, or alters the download of Claude's workspace, which advised a restart or a reinstall and could not be closed. It now offers Retry, says what to ask an IT administrator to allow, and can be closed where tasks go on without the workspace.
  • Fixed workspace notices such as "Additional setup needed" covering a permission request or the message box in a short or zoomed-in window, which hid the request and could make Deny and Allow once unclickable.

3P

  • Added deploymentMode (not read from a bootstrap server): the app runs only on your third-party setup (3p), only signed in to Claude.ai (1p), or as each person chooses (any). Older versions read only disableDeploymentModeChooser, which Setup no longer offers: for 3p, set it to true too.
  • Added inferenceGatewayAutoModeServerChecks, a temporary setting, off unless you turn it on, that has the provider behind your gateway check risky Auto mode actions by sending it session details such as folder paths and a user name.
  • Added platformOverrides to sessionStatusLine, to run a different status line program on Windows, macOS or Linux. An older version rejects the whole setting when this is present and shows no status line, so add it only after all devices are updated.
  • Added a warning to the app's log and diagnostic report when a Claude Console sign-in's organization is missing from a device profile's forceLoginOrgUUID list. A coming release will allow only listed organizations, so add your Console organization's ID to the list now.
  • Added the Monitor tool to Code sessions where Bash is available: each new batch of a watched command's output starts a turn, with nobody typing. Turn it off with Monitor in disabledBuiltinTools.
  • (breaking) Changed an unset desktopHome to read as standard at launches after 12:00 PM PT on November 10, 2026, even where chatSessionRetentionDays is set. New conversations that are Cowork tasks are deleted by coworkSessionRetentionDays, not chatSessionRetentionDays, so set both.
  • (breaking) Changed SSH on Windows to reach hosts new to the device (every host, on PCs that keep no app data) through Microsoft OpenSSH 9.4 or newer, not the built-in library. To stay on the library, set sshTransport to builtin everywhere you manage settings. Mac and Linux then use it too.
  • Changed inferenceModelPricingEnabled: when on, each session's estimated cost now shows above the message box in Cowork, Chat and Code, not only on the Usage page. Where sessionStatusLine is set, its program's line shows there instead.
  • Changed a PreToolUse or PermissionRequest hook whose command is only a quoted path or string, with no shell, args or "onFailure": "continue", to block calls on PCs without Git for Windows. Install Git and reopen Claude, or for an .exe unquote it, add "args": [], "onFailure": "block".
  • Changed a setting left past its deprecation date, such as organizationPluginsUrl, to be ignored, not an error. A device profile holding only such settings no longer locks local settings or sets aside the Admin Console's configuration, whose retention periods then delete idle sessions for good.
  • Changed Code sessions on Linux hosts where AppArmor stops the sandbox, such as Ubuntu 24.04 over SSH: shell commands that failed now run unsandboxed, so coworkEgressAllowedHosts and allowedWorkspaceFolders don't limit them. An AppArmor profile for bubblewrap on the host restores it.
  • Changed how autoMode lists in Claude Code's managed-settings.json apply in local Code sessions and Cowork tasks: an allow list without "$defaults" replaces the built-in exceptions, and a soft_deny or environment list without it adds to the built-in rules. Auto mode may ask or block more.
  • Changed recurring scheduled tasks to retry for up to about three and a half hours, up from about one, when the inference provider can't be reached. Claude notifies you of the first failure and the final outcome, and when tasks are waiting for you to sign in again.
  • Changed SSH from Windows over OpenSSH: each connection signs in at least twice and keeps the sign-ins open, so a per-user login limit must leave room and a one-time code or push is asked at each. The sign-in dialog offers Remember password, and the SSH sessions docs page says how to turn it off.
  • Changed the Code tab on devices whose only configuration is a local file, even one copied by a script: with coworkEgressAllowedHosts unset and blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories off, shell commands can reach the network. An empty list still blocks them where Claude Code's sandbox runs.
  • Changed which program opens SSH connections from Windows over OpenSSH, now the default: ssh.exe, not Claude.exe. Where a firewall or endpoint rule allows SSH by program, allow ssh.exe too. If it starts but can't reach the network, the connection fails and the built-in library does not step in.
  • Deprecated coworkTabEnabled, chatTabEnabled and chatAdvancedFileAnalysisEnabled: desktopHome replaces them. Remove them before 12:00 PM PT on December 17, 2026. Users see a warning from November 17 while one is still set.
  • Deprecated sessionRetentionHold (Suspend session deletion): ignored from 12:00 PM PT on December 17, 2026, when retention periods permanently delete idle sessions it kept. To keep them, first set all three periods to 3650 days where they are set. Once devices have the new periods, remove the key.
  • Removed the Chat and Cowork switch from a project's page under Unified Claude. A message sent there now starts a Cowork task, or a chat on a computer that can't run Cowork.
  • Removed the Send to Anthropic button from the diagnostic report. To share a report, export it to a file from Help > Troubleshooting > Generate Diagnostic Report.
  • Updated the app to the new Claude look: new colors, icons and type. In Cowork and Chat, Claude's steps and progress notes now sit behind one status row, which opens with a click.
  • Fixed a "Get set up for agent mode" download prompt appearing in chats and tasks.
  • Fixed cases where remote connectors asked people to sign in again: after a brief server or network error while their sign-in renewed in the background, after their organization plugin's folder was briefly missing, or when they signed in just as the connector reconnected by itself.
  • Fixed certificate settings such as NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS in the env of Claude Code's managed-settings.json not taking effect in some sessions, such as Chat and Cowork. Settings already in that file now take effect, so review them before rolling out.
  • Fixed Claude Desktop opening on Code, or showing "Code has been disabled by your organization’s administrator.", at launch when the Admin Console or a configuration server turns Chat on and Cowork off.
  • Fixed local and WSL Code sessions that stopped when the app quit or restarted for an update. When you return to one within a day, the app sends one automatic message, shown as yours, asking Claude to continue. That turn uses tokens on your organization's provider.
  • Fixed skills that could not be renamed or edited on some Windows virtual desktops with redirected user profiles.
  • Fixed the app window and the Setup window growing larger than the screen on small displays or with Windows Text size or Display scale set high, which left the window buttons, the message box and Apply Changes out of reach.

item.title: v4.4212.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.309.

General

  • Added a per-site "Local network access" setting to the built-in browser's menu, with a question the first time a site tries, for sign-in pages that check a desktop agent such as Okta Verify and for sites that talk to devices on your network.
  • Added Cowork's notes to the import from Claude (third-party): where device management turned it on and no HIPAA restriction applies, Settings > Import shows the notes Cowork kept there and can add them to your Claude memory, where memory import is available.
  • Added Send to options for partner apps, such as Canva, in the Share menu when a Claude Doc is open on its own page.
  • Changed disableBrowserExternalNavigation and browserExternalPageTools in a device's Claude Code managed settings (managed-settings.json, or its MDM or HKLM policy) to apply even when the claude.ai admin console also has managed settings.
  • Removed opening the application menu by pressing Alt on its own on GNOME, so that switching keyboard layouts with Alt+Shift no longer opens it. F10 still opens the menu.
  • Fixed a reply with two or more cards, such as weather or message drafts, showing only one of them, or showing a card with the wrong pictures or places.
  • Fixed background computer use treating a window that had been closed as still open on another desktop, which made Claude click into nothing or ask for full-screen control.
  • Fixed the message box sometimes opening without its saved draft, and not keeping what you typed as a draft, when two windows loaded at the same time, for example right after signing in.
  • Fixed the side panel opening on its own over the conversation in a narrow window when a reply created an artifact or shared a file, which hid the reply and the message box, including from screen readers.

Code

  • Changed remoteControlAtStartup: false in a device's Claude Code managed settings (managed-settings.json, or its MDM or HKLM policy) to apply even when the claude.ai admin console also has managed settings.
  • Changed SSH connections through a proxy command or jump host on Mac and Linux, where your SSH config sets no ConnectTimeout, to get a longer second try so a slow route has time to come up; the sign-in dialog for a jump host (ProxyJump) no longer closes after 30 seconds.
  • Fixed a message to a new or just-cleared SSH session being refused while the host was unreachable: it now waits and is sent when the host is back, and messages waiting for an unreachable host no longer send by themselves before your organization's settings have loaded.
  • Fixed Rewind on the first message shown in a very large session clearing the whole conversation.
  • Fixed sessions on an SSH machine losing their connection when an sshHostCommands command makes a new one; "Replace …'s host" is now "Create another …", available a minute after the last machine is made.
  • Fixed SSH set-up failing at once when Anthropic's download server is busy, and sessions showing only "Reconnecting" when Claude Code couldn't be set up on the host: the app now tries again, names the cause, and offers Retry now.
  • Fixed the first message after an SSH session starts or reconnects sometimes silently running without your MCP servers.

Cowork

  • Fixed a generic error banner sometimes appearing beside the Paused card after safeguards flagged a message.
  • Fixed a stopped tool call showing a message written for Claude as a failure.
  • Fixed Cmd+Shift+S and Cmd+Shift+B answering on their QWERTY keys under Dvorak and other remapped keyboard layouts.
  • Fixed dismissed notices under a reply, such as crisis support or election information, coming back after leaving a chat and returning to it.
  • Fixed furigana (readings above Japanese text) in replies showing as raw HTML tags, and Find counting the hidden tag text and missing words under two readings.
  • Fixed Return in a background Mac app's text field adding a line break to the field instead of submitting it.

3P

  • Added projectsEnabled. Set it to false to hide projects in Chat and Cowork. Projects are not deleted, and they come back when the setting is turned on again.
  • Added sessionStatusLine to show one line of text above the message box in Cowork, Chat and Code, printed by a program that the app runs. On macOS and Linux the program and every folder above it must be writable only by root, and on Windows it must be in Program Files on the system drive.
  • Added skillScanningEnabled (beta): run a security scan on each skill a user creates or uploads before it can be used. Skills that fail the security scan are blocked.
  • Added a per-site "Local network access" setting to the built-in browser (builtinBrowserEnabled). When an https site first tries to reach an app on this computer or a device on your network, the user is asked whether to allow it. builtinBrowserBlockedDomains can block devices, not local apps.
  • Added Escape to close a side pane of a chat or Cowork task, such as a file or connector pane, when focus is in the pane, and return focus to what opened it. While Claude is replying, Escape in a pane closes the pane, and a second Escape stops the reply.
  • (breaking) Changed an unset desktopHome to read as standard at launches after 12:00 PM PT on November 10, 2026: Unified Claude opens with Cowork on, even where coworkTabEnabled is false.
  • Changed sshClientPath (beta) on Windows to accept a path starting with %LOCALAPPDATA%\ when machine-wide policy (HKLM) sets it, with sshTransport: system-openssh, and Claude does not run as administrator. Whoever replaces a program there can see SSH passwords and get around sshHostAllowlist.
  • Changed Code sessions to ask for approval before starting a dev server from launch.json in Auto and Bypass permissions modes, where Claude Code's sandbox (the default on macOS, Linux and WSL) or deny or ask rules in managed settings limit shell commands.
  • Changed Cowork to show "Billing issue", with no Try again button, in place of "Something went wrong" when your inference provider or gateway refuses a request with HTTP 402.
  • Changed provider API keys saved in Setup to be encrypted where the computer has secure storage. Keys saved earlier are encrypted at the next launch. Versions below 4.29 cannot read them, so after a rollback below 4.29, or a move of the app's data to another computer or account, enter the key again.
  • Fixed Settings > Usage and the token limit set with inferenceMaxTokensPerWindow leaving out requests that the app makes itself, such as naming a session. These now count toward the limit, and once it is reached the app stops making them, except its connection check.
  • Fixed the connection banner's Details and "Copy report for IT" not mentioning managed settings that were not fully applied. Each one is now listed as a warning, and when the connection works, apps configured from a local file also show the "Configuration may need attention" banner.

item.title: v4.29.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.309.

General

  • Fixed a new chat whose first reply was stopped early refusing every later message with “That chat is no longer available.”
  • Fixed deleting a folder on Windows sometimes also deleting files outside it, through a junction or a mounted volume inside it.
  • Fixed session starts waiting a minute each, until the app restarted, for a local MCP server whose launch hangs.
  • Fixed the automatic local cleanup, in organizations with the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration, deleting work on an out-of-date retention period after an admin changed it, or on the member’s own or the default period when the admin’s value was invalid.
  • Fixed the window sometimes staying blank until you quit the app after a page stopped responding, and the app reloading its window after a long freeze even though the page had started responding again.
  • Fixed words in a new chat’s message box being lost when the app returned to New chat because the first message failed to send or the chat turned out not to exist, and a too-long message being lost when its Retry was refused while a newer draft was in the message box.

Code

  • Changed which CLAUDE_*, ANTHROPIC_* and DISABLE_* variables SSH and WSL sessions take from your computer’s environment: most settings, on/off values and numbers still go; most other text, such as a cloud provider’s key or base URL, goes only if saved under Environment variables.
  • Fixed archiving an SSH or WSL session removing its worktree with uncommitted changes after a cancelled start.
  • Fixed environments saved from another window or device disappearing when a window that had been open for a while saved its own list.
  • Fixed messages being lost: queued messages in a local session when Claude Code crashed or stopped responding mid-turn, which now stay queued until you send them, and an unsent message to an SSH or WSL session when you pressed Esc with text in the message box.
  • Fixed SSH sessions failing to connect or start when a background job from the host’s start-up file prints text after login or the host’s SSH config sets SessionType, when the connection dropped as a session started, and on some hosts with a false “shell start-up files” error.
  • Fixed the app resending an SSH password after the server had refused it and disconnected, which could lock the account.

Cowork

  • Changed deleting a task or a Dispatch chat so that, when the deletion can’t be completed, it is kept with an error and you can try again. Deleting a Dispatch chat also removes earlier copies of it on this computer.
  • Changed Skip all approvals to follow your organization’s Cowork setting instead of its Claude Code settings. A device’s own Claude Code managed settings still apply. When an admin turns it or Auto off, tasks in that mode drop lower at their next start or message. Not in third-party deployments.
  • Changed web fetch in scheduled tasks, outside Auto and Skip all approvals modes, to need a URL named in the task’s instructions or found by search or an earlier fetch. Not in third-party deployments.
  • Fixed a task that could stay stuck on “working” after a follow-up message’s attachment failed to upload, or after you pressed Stop while an attachment was still uploading.
  • Fixed computer use working in the background on Mac replacing all the text in a field when the app was slow to respond, leaving a field you were typing in selected so one key press wiped it, sending clicks aimed outside a window to its edge, and getting stuck at Finder’s Go to Folder.
  • Fixed shell commands continuing to run, or starting, after you pressed Stop.

3P

  • Added behavesAs to inferenceModels entries. It names the Claude model behind a gateway alias or other Model ID that Claude Desktop can’t identify, so the ID gets that model’s effort levels and limits. Once any entry sets it, sessions ignore modelPicker in people’s own Claude Code settings.
  • Added defaultState to remote managedMcpServers entries. Set it to off to provide a connector that stays out of each person’s sessions until they turn it on under Connectors in the + menu. Adding off to a connector in use turns it off for everyone who has not switched it on.
  • Added oauth.omitResource to remote managedMcpServers entries, for an identity provider that rejects the OAuth resource parameter, as Microsoft Entra ID can (AADSTS9010010). It needs oauth.clientId, an API oauth.scope and exactly one sign-in server, or the server is not loaded.
  • Added platformOverrides to local, remote and web search managedMcpServers entries, so that one configuration can give a server a different command, arguments, environment or helper on Windows, macOS and Linux. An invalid value under any one of them drops the server on every device.
  • Added toolTimeoutSec to local and remote managedMcpServers entries. It sets how many seconds, 5 to 3,600, a tool call to that one server may run, in place of mcpToolTimeoutSec for that server.
  • Added a warning in Cowork, Chat and Code once a person has used 75% of the token limit set with inferenceMaxTokensPerWindow and inferenceTokenWindowHours. Set inferenceTokenWarningPercent (1 to 100) to change the percent. At the limit it reads “Token limit reached” and cannot be closed.
  • Changed managedMcpServers entries with server: "github" so that pull_request_review_write asks before every call, comment-only reviews and thread resolves included, even when toolPolicy allows it. Where no prompt can be shown, the call is refused. toolPolicy can still block it.
  • Changed a failed PreToolUse or PermissionRequest hook with "shell": "powershell" to block the call on PCs without Git for Windows unless it sets args or "onFailure": "continue". If written for Bash: remove shell, add "onFailure": "block" to keep blocking, install Git, reopen Claude.
  • Changed an unset desktopHome to open Unified Claude at launches after 12:00 PM PT on November 10, 2026. With Cowork on, a set chatSessionRetentionDays without an equal coworkSessionRetentionDays keeps the current view.
  • Changed chatTabEnabled and chatAdvancedFileAnalysisEnabled to have no effect where an unset desktopHome with Cowork on starts to open Unified Claude (November 10, 2026).
  • Changed Chat, Cowork and Code sessions to no longer start while Claude’s provider connection settings are missing, invalid or not yet fetched from your organization’s server. Claude says so at once.
  • Changed the Microsoft 365 connector to keep each saved sign-in per tenantId, clientId, azureCloud and continuousAccessEvaluation. Connected users sign in again once after this update. Where microsoftAuthDefaultAccount is enabled on Windows, they get the account picker from then on.
  • Improved the “Configuration sync issue” banner for a fetched configuration with no connection settings that Claude can use. It now says to contact your administrator and adds “Copy report for IT”.
  • Updated the built-in GitHub connector to github-mcp-server v2.0.2. New tools that make changes ask before every call by default: update_issue_comment and, in toolsets that are off by default, create_repository_ruleset, custom_properties_write and assign_copilot_to_issue_with_intent.
  • Fixed Cowork and Chat saying that a connector your organization set up needs authorization or failed to connect, when Claude Code’s own configuration on the device, such as managed-mcp.json, lists a server of the same name. Cowork and Chat now leave out the device’s server of that name.
  • Fixed Cowork and Chat showing an error when Claude Code’s process was ended from outside the app while idle after a response had finished. On macOS that error blamed security software.
  • Fixed memory being impossible to pause when Cowork is turned off. Memory’s settings are now in Settings > General.
  • Fixed the Setup window leaving a typed value out of the saved or exported configuration: a host typed in “Allowed egress hosts” or “SSH host allowlist” before pressing Tab, or a tool picked under “Disabled built-in tools” without Add. Saving is now blocked while a JSON field holds invalid text.

item.title: v3.6556.1
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.308.

General

  • Changed read-only allowedWorkspaceFolders entries with an unset or unsupported %VAR% (any on SSH hosts): the folder holding it turns read-only (~/Work for ~/Work/%X%/a), or every allowed folder if it starts the entry. Another system’s variable (%APPDATA% on macOS or SSH) is still ignored.
  • Fixed chats from an interrupted bulk delete coming back with no notice; the next launch now lists them.
  • Fixed dictation problems: keyboard focus being lost or jumping behind an open dialog when a recording starts or ends, a click or Enter meant to finish a dictation sending your message when the recording had just failed, and an empty recording moving the cursor to the start of your draft.
  • Fixed editing a new chat’s first message while it was still sending, which sent the edit to a chat that did not exist and lost it. Edit now appears once Claude starts to reply.
  • Fixed renaming an open artifact from its title menu reloading it and clearing anything you had typed or selected in it.
  • Fixed Reset App Data on Windows sometimes deleting files outside Claude’s data folder.

Code

  • Added SSH connections in the macOS and Linux apps that get their host from your own command: add an entry with an id, name and command under sshHostCommands in your Claude Code settings, then choose "Create" with its name in the environment menu. Not in third-party deployments.
  • Added the ability for Claude to press keys such as Return, Delete and the arrows, rotate the simulator, and show or hide the on-screen keyboard in the iOS Simulator.
  • Changed allowedWorkspaceFolders on SSH hosts: an entry is left out, and allows nothing, unless it is a full path for that host (~/work, not work; on Windows C:\work, not \work) with no ... A symbolic link listed inside another listed folder is left out too: list the folder it points to.
  • Changed a folder’s permission mode to be saved separately for this computer, each SSH host, and each WSL distribution. Folders set to Bypass permissions start in their default mode until you pick it again and confirm; on SSH and WSL, earlier picks more permissive than their default no longer apply.
  • Fixed deleting a session right after opening it, which left its transcript on this computer.
  • Fixed SSH sessions being ended or auto-archived while their task was still running, messages sent during a connection loss never being delivered, sessions opening with only part of their history, and refused sign-ins being retried in the background, which could count toward the host’s lock-out.
  • Fixed the cloud environment editor losing, changing or reordering environment variables, and adding backslashes, when a value mixes quotes and backslashes or contains both kinds of quote.

Cowork

  • Changed MCP tools that their server marks as needing a person to ask only on the in-app card, so their notifications have no Allow button and scheduled tasks go on without those calls.
  • Removed /schedule from the slash menu; typing it now fills in a request to schedule the task, like the Schedule button.
  • Fixed Claude not finding your plugins and skills in scheduled tasks and other tasks not open on screen, except in third-party deployments.
  • Fixed earlier tasks missing from the list on some Windows computers where an older version of the app had started blank and signed out. They come back the next time the app starts.
  • Fixed screen readers saying only “Claude wants to use:” when focus moves to a request to use your computer, without naming the apps or access it asks for.
  • Fixed the notice for a failed workspace start sometimes not appearing, and tasks started from a plugin’s setup card, a connector’s suggested prompts or an onboarding suggestion being silently dropped after Claude’s workspace failed to start.

3P

  • Added headersHelperArgs and envHelperArgs to managedMcpServers entries: arguments for the entry’s headersHelper or envHelper, so one helper script can serve several servers.
  • Added installedUpdateEnforcementEnabled and installedUpdateEnforcementHours. With disableAutoUpdates and the first true, Claude restarts into a version installed while open after the second’s hours (1 to 72; unset: 72, then once idle). On Windows (MSIX) it may stay closed until reopened.
  • Added quickEntryScreenshotsEnabled and quickEntryFileSharingEnabled on macOS. Set to false, they turn off screenshots (and the Screen Recording request) and attaching the file open in another app (and the Accessibility request), in Quick Entry and in @-mentions of an app’s window.
  • Added a “Relaunch to update” notice on macOS, Linux and Windows (MSIX installs) when a newer version is installed while the app is open on a device with disableAutoUpdates set.
  • Added cached token counts, read and written, to each tab on Settings > Usage, so that the tokens behind the estimated cost can be seen.
  • Added Storage to Settings > This computer > System: it shows the disk space Claude uses, lets you free up space by deleting inactive chats and Cowork tasks and cleaning up inactive Code sessions, and opens from the new low-disk-space warning or with /storage in Chat, Cowork and Code.
  • Changed sshClientPath (beta) on Windows to accept Git for Windows’ ssh.exe or another OpenSSH 8.5 or newer under Program Files. Device management, or the bootstrap server it names, must set the key and also set sshTransport to system-openssh.
  • Changed the approval prompt for managedMcpServers from a bootstrap server: for a remote connector with a helper script, it now shows where the helper’s output is sent and asks again when that address changes. People who approved such a connector are asked once more after updating.
  • Changed the built-in GitHub connector to ask before every call of issue_write, sub_issue_write, pull_request_review_write, add_reply_to_pull_request_comment and five write tools that toolsets can enable. An exact toolPolicy key, or "*", can still allow them.
  • Changed the built-in GitHub connector’s actions_run_trigger tool to ask before every call whatever toolPolicy says. toolPolicy can still block it.
  • Changed the built-in Microsoft 365 connector’s tool for reading files, messages and folders to ask for approval once more in Chat and Cowork after this update, where “Always allow” had been chosen.
  • Changed the Setup window’s firewall allowlist to list hcaptcha.com and *.hcaptcha.com for sign-ins on Anthropic’s pages (Claude Console, admin console, Claude.ai import) and the hosts of MCP servers and plugin marketplaces that a bootstrap server or the admin console delivers. Export it again.
  • Changed update checks to use releases.claude.com when bootstrapUrl is on config.claude.com and bootstrapEnabled is not off, even with updateViaUpdatesHost off.
  • Improved how quickly Cowork lists recent tasks and chats at launch when many sessions are saved: recent ones appear first, with a placeholder row at the end of the list while older ones load.
  • Fixed Cowork and Code showing empty session, project and scheduled-task lists when the app starts while the bootstrap server is unreachable, on devices that fetched their configuration before and whose profile sets no inferenceProvider. Scheduled tasks now wait until the connection is restored.
  • Fixed Cowork’s live list of steps and progress notes showing only when a reply began with steps. It now follows whichever steps Claude is working on, also after text or an answered question.
  • Fixed gateway sessions quietly running a newer Opus when Opus 4 or 4.1 was picked. The picked model is now requested. If your gateway, or the provider behind it, no longer serves it, sessions and scheduled tasks on it now fail: remove it from your model list and move those tasks to another model.
  • Fixed plugins being uninstalled when an admin moves an allowedPluginMarketplaces entry to a new source: in the same change, set the new entry’s expectedName to the old marketplace’s name. Plugins that the marketplace takes from another repository are still uninstalled.
  • Fixed plugins installed from a marketplace folder on this computer having no Settings tab on their page in Customize, so Code tab sessions ran them without the values they ask for. Values entered earlier in a terminal must be entered again in that tab.
  • Fixed Quick Entry not starting anything; a Quick Entry prompt now starts a session.

item.title: v3.1623.4
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.308.

General

  • Changed plugins that the app loads to ask before using the tools they pre-approve when your organization's Claude Code managed settings, such as managed-settings.json, set allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly.

Code

  • Fixed GitHub's MCP server write tools showing a form that closed without creating anything.

Cowork

  • No user-facing changes.

3P

  • Changed which servers in Claude Code's managed-mcp.json are stopped by isLocalDevMcpEnabled set to false or by allowedPluginMcpServers: a local MCP server that uses ${VAR} only in its env values now runs. One with a variable in its command or arguments is still stopped.
  • Fixed every request failing when a gateway or cloud provider rejects tool search; the request is now sent again without it.

item.title: v3.1623.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.304.

General

  • Added Storage to Settings. It shows the disk space Claude uses and lets you free up space by removing inactive Cowork tasks and Code sessions; a low disk space warning opens it, and so does typing /storage in Cowork and Code. Not yet available on third-party deployments.
  • Changed the minimum Windows version to Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041). PCs on an older Windows keep the version of Claude they have, and the Microsoft Store version is unchanged.
  • Removed the "Open external link" confirmation for most links to other websites. Third-party deployments keep it.
  • Fixed messages that had not finished sending being lost after a reload: a failed or still-uploading first message now returns to New chat, an edited message that failed to send reopens in its edit box, and a notice says when a message wasn't sent.
  • Fixed pop-out windows (Projects, Code sessions, side panes) closing for good when you sign in again or the app reloads its window; they now reopen.
  • Fixed saving a skill failing, and sessions starting without skills, on Windows when the full path of the app's skills folder has 260 characters or more.
  • Fixed the app freezing on macOS when Claude asked for permission to use an app and the system did not provide that app's icon.

Code

  • (breaking) Changed disableDesktopLocalSessions in Claude Code's managed settings so that the text "true" turns off local sessions, as the boolean does; earlier versions ignored the text.
  • (breaking) Changed sshHostAllowlist in claude.ai admin settings and in Claude Code's managed settings to also cover a session's jump hosts: each ProxyJump host, and the host in a ProxyCommand written ssh -W %h:%p host, must be on each list that is set, by its HostName.
  • (breaking) Changed local sessions where claude.ai admin settings apply: a Claude Code managed-settings file on the computer that fails to load now keeps Code sessions from starting or resuming on that computer until it is fixed.
  • (breaking) Changed local sessions where claude.ai admin settings apply: the local-session ban (disableDesktopLocalSessions) in the computer's own Claude Code managed settings now applies too, so Code sessions on that computer no longer start or resume; sessions already running continue.
  • (breaking) Changed saved SSH passwords where claude.ai admin settings apply: the saved-password ban (disableSshSavedPasswords) in the computer's own Claude Code managed settings now applies too; passwords already saved are kept but are not offered or used.
  • (breaking) Changed SSH sessions on macOS and Linux hosts to not start when the host can't report the real location of one of the session's folders. The error says to start a new session from paths with no symbolic links.
  • (breaking) Changed SSH sessions to stop starting the MCP servers from your desktop settings on a remote host whose administrator uses Claude Code's managed-mcp.json to allow only their own servers.
  • (breaking) Changed SSH where claude.ai admin settings apply: hosts missing from sshHostAllowlist in the computer's own Claude Code managed settings are refused, whatever admin settings allow. An empty or malformed list turns SSH off; with no list there, only the admin settings list applies.
  • (breaking) Changed the Browser pane in SSH sessions to keep sign-ins separate for each session and only until you quit the app, to open localhost (your computer) and private-network addresses only when you type them, and to no longer open intranet sites at public-looking names, even when typed.
  • (breaking) Changed WSL sessions, and SSH sessions on macOS and Linux hosts, to stop using an added folder whose saved path is relative, starts with //, or starts or ends with a space, the next time the session starts. The folder stays listed in the session.
  • Removed "Download file" for script files such as .js, .bat and .ps1 shown as text in SSH, WSL, cloud and Remote Control sessions; Copy file contents remains.
  • Fixed an app update or restart ending work on an SSH host: sessions in the Windows app now carry on with a task still running on the host instead of starting it afresh, and on macOS and Linux a restart after an update no longer ends a task, or drops a permission prompt, older than three days.
  • Fixed messages queued or sent in a local session while Claude was working being lost when the app quit, updated or crashed; they now come back at the next launch, held until you send them.
  • Fixed removing an inactive session's worktree, from Settings or through Claude, also deleting an archived session's worktree nested inside it, including uncommitted changes; both are now kept, and a worktree that gains uncommitted changes after a clean preview is kept too.
  • Fixed SSH sessions in the macOS and Linux apps failing to connect to servers that allow only one session per connection (MaxSessions 1). The app now signs in separately for each connection it opens there, so a server that asks for a one-time code at every sign-in asks more than once.
  • Fixed the automatic local cleanup deleting a session's Remote Control conversation on claude.ai, for organizations with the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration; the conversation is now archived.

Cowork

  • Added a Hand off to Claude Code option to the menu under a design's name. It opens Claude Code with a prompt to build the design in your codebase, or gives you the prompt to paste.
  • Changed the import from Claude (third-party) where device management turned it on: a copied Cowork task or project now keeps an attached home, Documents or ~/Claude folder. Folders above home and system folders such as ~/Library or AppData are still left out.
  • Fixed global instructions sometimes reverting to an earlier version after an older task was archived, deleted, cleaned up or continued.
  • Fixed recently opened tasks being removed by the automatic local cleanup after an app restart, for organizations with the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration.
  • Fixed the folder picker sometimes showing "Couldn't load" until the page was reloaded.

3P

  • Added quickEntryDefaultShortcut, which sets the Quick Entry shortcut, or off for none, for users who have not chosen their own in Settings.
  • Added releaseChannel. Set it to staggered to have devices update to releases that Anthropic marks after they have fully rolled out on stable; those devices skip the releases in between, and fixes reach them later.
  • Added an optional icon to remote and local managedMcpServers entries, a PNG or JPEG image as a base64 data: URI of up to 4,096 characters, shown so users can tell connectors apart.
  • Added nested sessions to local and SSH sessions in the Code tab: Claude can start a task in a separate session, which appears under the original session in the sidebar and reports back to it. Each nested session sends its own requests to your inference provider.
  • Added the new Code tab: the New session page with saved environments (folders and SSH hosts), the session rail, sidebar grouping by environment, and the pickers under the message box. Anthropic-hosted cloud environments, Remote Control, voice input and worktrees for extra folders remain unavailable.
  • Added to Code tab sessions Claude's plan and a next-step box at the end of a turn, suggested next actions, /btw side chats in a pane, and permission requests, questions and suggested tasks shown in the conversation.
  • (breaking) Changed sshHostAllowlist (beta) to also cover a session's jump hosts: each ProxyJump host, and the host in a ProxyCommand written ssh -W %h:%p host, must be on the list by its HostName. The error on a refused session names the host to add.
  • Changed "Sign in with Claude Console" to keep your sign-in instead of creating an API key in your organization. The app keeps using a key created by an earlier version until you next sign in.
  • Changed builtinToolPolicy to accept every built-in tool name Claude Code publishes, so an entry for a tool such as CronCreate or LSP is no longer dropped.
  • Changed isLocalDevMcpEnabled: false also stops local MCP servers from plugins (your organization's marketplaces included), from Claude Code's managed-mcp.json if they use ${VAR}, and in Code from Claude Code's own configuration files. Remote and org-plugins directory servers still run.
  • Changed subagents in Code tab sessions to run in the background even when Claude asks for the foreground, so they keep running after Stop; Claude can also now start a fork of the conversation as a subagent.
  • Changed the restart when a device-management profile that sets more than the app-behavior keys first applies while the app runs on a user's own saved configuration: the dialog appears right away, not after relaunchEnforcementHours.
  • Fixed "Or sign in with Claude.ai" leaving "Couldn't connect to Claude" at every launch where claude.ai is blocked: a launch with nobody signed in to Claude.ai now returns to the organization's sign-in page. On managed devices the error screen also has a "Sign in with your organization" button.
  • Fixed Claude in Cowork being told to save its work in a connected folder under an allowedWorkspaceFolders entry whose mode is ro. Claude is now told which folders are read-only and to save new files and edited copies in a writable connected folder or, if there is none, the outputs folder.
  • Fixed importing the same folder or exported zip again from Settings > Import & export creating a second copy of every session. Repeating an import made with an earlier version still copies its sessions once more.
  • Fixed the environment variables editor failing to open or save, plugin command permissions being forgotten at every restart, and adding a project's folders again not restoring Chat's access to them, after the app's data folder was moved to another computer or the system keychain was reset.

item.title: v2.42304.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.299.

General

  • Changed the certificate that signs the bundled Claude Code helper (claude.exe) on Windows to the renewed one that the app and its installer have used since v2.37337.1. Rules that hold the certificate itself, such as a Microsoft Defender certificate indicator, need the new certificate added beside the old one.
  • Changed the import from Claude (third-party) where device management turned it on: after the import, Claude now adds local MCP servers and starts those that were on, installs the desktop extensions and uploaded plugins that your organization allows, and, where your organization allows skill creation, uploads skills that grant tools or declare hooks, all without asking you to confirm. Before, each local MCP server waited for you to confirm its command and settings. Organizations under the HIPAA restriction get none of these.
  • Improved the import from Claude (third-party): copied scheduled tasks keep their files and folders. Where device management turned it on and no HIPAA restriction applies, Settings > Import offers your instructions for Claude and Cowork, and tasks keep tool approvals for unchanged local MCP servers.
  • Fixed Arabic and Hebrew text reading in the wrong order in chat titles, session titles, messages, plans, search results, file views, feedback dialogs and the Code tab.
  • Fixed some plugins never installing after being enabled on claude.ai because one of their files is very repetitive, such as a long empty table.
  • Fixed some Update buttons planning a restart with nothing on screen while sessions were still running; they now ask first and can be cancelled.
  • Fixed the app sometimes starting with no window open, including after restarting from the Help menu on Windows and Linux when the app had started automatically at sign-in.
  • Fixed tool approval prompts staying hidden behind a full-screen MCP app after the chat preview was closed.

Code

  • Added a Context card to the session rail, to the right of the conversation. On plans with usage limits, the ring under the message box now shows plan usage, and context usage is in this card. If the rail is hidden, use the Show session rail button at top right (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Added a session rail to the right of the conversation, with cards including the session's environment, context, connectors, outputs, changes, servers, and background tasks. Right-click a card's header to choose which cards show (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Added environments: save a folder, SSH host, cloud environment, or Remote Control machine, with a worktree and branch setting for each folder, and pick one when you start a session. "Save as environment" at the top of a session saves where it started (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Added nested sessions in local and SSH sessions: Claude can start a task in a separate session, which appears under the original session in the sidebar and reports back to it. In Settings > Claude Code, choose what happens when you ask for an unrelated task (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Added a box at the end of the conversation in local and SSH sessions that shows Claude's plan while it works. When a turn ends, the box can show a short recap with buttons for what to do next (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Added Environment to the sidebar's Group by menu. It groups sessions by their saved local or SSH environment, or by folder or repository when they have none. Custom groups are now called sections (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed the New session page: choose where Claude runs and which folder to use in the row under the message box, or pick a recent environment from the card on the page. For a Git folder, Branch and Worktree are at the bottom of the folder menu (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed the sidebar's Filter button to Group and sort, which appears when you hover a group heading. Use it to change grouping or sorting, show routines or empty groups, or open View all for archived sessions (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed pull request controls to appear in the Changes card on the session rail, instead of in a bar above the message box. Each open pull request's menu has Auto-fix, Merge when ready, and auto-archive options (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed the folder and repository menu to appear in the Environment card on the session rail, next to the branch and Remote Control, instead of in the session's title bar (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed the row under the message box to hold the permission mode, one menu for model and effort, and the usage ring. The + menu and the microphone moved inside the message box (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed /btw in local sessions to open a side chat in a pane beside the session, with a tab for each side chat (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed permission requests and questions to appear in the conversation instead of above the message box. In local and SSH sessions, suggested tasks appear there too (not yet in third-party deployments).
  • Changed the Git operations the app runs for you (the commit and stash around a branch switch, the in-folder branch switch, and the push behind "Continue in cloud") to no longer run repository Git hooks; push Git LFS objects from a terminal before continuing in the cloud.
  • Removed the "Get started with Claude Code" checklist from the sidebar.
  • Fixed "Rewind to here" failing with "Can’t rewind to this message." on any message but the latest in cloud and self-hosted sessions.
  • Fixed deleting a session on an SSH host whose helper had not yet updated also deleting a branch holding unpushed commits.
  • Fixed SSH sessions silently losing part of Claude's output, getting stuck reconnecting after another session on the same host failed to start, and ending the terminal on Windows computers when the host closed the connection.
  • Fixed untracked files in a session's worktrees being deleted when the session was archived after Claude moved it to the cloud.

Cowork

  • Changed computer use on macOS to no longer save files into hidden or protected folders, such as Homebrew's folders and shell start-up locations, or give a document a hidden or otherwise protected name.
  • Changed Settings › Import to no longer offer the third-party app’s local MCP servers for organizations under the HIPAA restriction.
  • Fixed computer use typing text twice into a busy web page in a background app.
  • Fixed Enter selecting a slash menu item instead of sending the message when a "/" word, such as "/s", came after other words.
  • Fixed the conversation sometimes jumping back to the bottom when you scroll up with Page Up, Shift+Space or the Up arrow key while Claude is responding.
  • Fixed the workspace sometimes failing to start on Windows with a connection timeout error.

3P

  • Added support in the macOS and Linux apps for SSH sessions carrying on across an app restart, and automatic recovery on every platform when Claude Code on the host is lost mid-task while the app is running: the app restarts it and continues the task, even with nobody at the computer.
  • (breaking) Changed what a failed PreToolUse hook does on Windows computers without Git for Windows: if it sets none of shell, args, or onFailure, it now blocks the tool call. Such a hook runs in PowerShell there, where a command written for Bash can fail, so a hook that matches every tool can block every tool call. This includes hooks in plugins and in Claude Code's managed settings (managed-settings.json or the Windows policy registry value), such as one that other software adds. Either install Git for Windows in its default location and then quit and reopen Claude, or put the hook's program in command and its arguments in args. Add "onFailure": "block" if a failed hook should still block the call.
  • Changed claudeAiImport.automatic3pImport to reinstall, without asking, the optional plugins that a user had switched on from any optional allowedPluginMarketplaces entry (GitHub, git, or a URL on any host) with the same source in the old and new organization, not only from the gateway or bootstrap origin. This includes computers that moved organizations before this version, at their first launch with it.
  • Changed mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled to also apply to Code sessions on the device, in WSL and over SSH: when it is false, MCP tool prompts offer "Allow for this session" instead of "Always allow", and scheduled tasks offer no lasting approval unless mcpScheduledTaskApprovalLifetimeDays is one day or more.
  • Changed Chat's file-analysis sandbox (chatAdvancedFileAnalysisEnabled) to reach the hosts in coworkEgressAllowedHosts, for example to install packages. As in Cowork, its commands run without an approval prompt. Before, it had no network access by default. With no list, or an empty one, it still has none.
  • Changed session export in Settings > Import & export to cover everything by default instead of the last 30 days and to list what the file includes and leaves out; the import of a Claude Desktop export file also starts on everything.
  • Fixed a message typed at the token limit being discarded in Cowork and Chat. The message shown at the limit now also says when the limit resets and, in Cowork and Chat, has a View usage button.
  • Fixed Code tab SSH sessions on Windows hosts without Git for Windows refusing every shell command with "Enterprise policy requires sandboxing". The refusal stays for organizations that deny or ask on Bash commands by pattern, or whose disabledBuiltinTools holds Bash (with or without a pattern), PowerShell with a pattern, or a name the app does not recognize.
  • Fixed connectors losing their saved sign-in when Claude starts while the macOS keychain is locked; the connector now says what to do.

item.title: v2.37337.1
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.295.

General

  • Added "Open in new window" for chats, so a conversation can stay open in its own window beside the main window.
  • (breaking) Removed the former managed-configuration key names isDxtEnabled, isDxtSignatureRequired, and isDxtDirectoryEnabled. In a profile that still uses one, the name is now an unrecognized key: its setting no longer applies and the deprecation notice no longer appears, so unsigned extensions load and, on standard deployments, extensions are allowed and the extension directory shows. Set isDesktopExtensionEnabled, isDesktopExtensionSignatureRequired, and isDesktopExtensionDirectoryEnabled to the same values. This differs from earlier notes for third-party deployments, which said extensions would be disabled and only signed extensions would load. A macOS profile or Windows user policy that holds only former names is no longer read as managed configuration, so the device becomes unmanaged. A Windows machine policy or Linux managed settings file that holds only former names is reported as a configuration error, and local settings stay disabled.
  • Changed the certificate that signs the Windows app and its installer to a renewed one from the same publisher. Rules that allow Claude by publisher are unaffected; rules that pin the certificate itself need the new certificate added beside the old one.
  • Fixed a message that failed to send being lost when the page reloaded; it now stays in the chat with its Retry.
  • Fixed chats losing access to this computer's files and apps when registering the computer took more than a few seconds.
  • Fixed computer use in the background taking your keyboard: a dropdown menu that a click or key opens in a background app is now closed again at once instead of swallowing what you type.
  • Fixed MCP servers and preview dev servers launched through npx or npm failing to start on Windows when Node is installed under Program Files or an argument contains a space.
  • Fixed new Cowork tasks and Code sessions still connecting through the previous proxy after a proxy auto-config (PAC) file's answer changed, which failed with connection errors until the app was restarted.
  • Fixed plugins loading without their skills and tools, scheduled tasks failing to load, folder reads, and "Open with Claude" failing when the Windows profile lives in an FSLogix or similar profile container.

Code

  • Added Auto save to the Files pane editor, with an option in the pane menu to turn it off.
  • Changed SSH on Windows to use only an ssh.exe found on PATH. A .bat, .cmd or .ps1 wrapper named ssh is no longer run.
  • Fixed Code sessions with hundreds of added folders failing to start on Windows.
  • Fixed file edits being skipped in SSH sessions on Mac hosts that use a worktree while the app is closed or the computer is asleep.
  • Fixed messages Claude wrote before a tool call disappearing into a collapsed group of tool calls.
  • Fixed sessions failing to start when many sessions that each use a worktree of a large repository start at the same time.
  • Fixed sessions that hold a very large prompt sometimes showing an error in place of the conversation.
  • Fixed sessions with background agents not continuing on their own after the 5-hour usage limit resets.
  • Fixed some Claude Code crashes on Windows that cut off a response showing "Session was interrupted" instead of the crash message with Try again.

Cowork

  • Improved the "workspace disk full" prompt so cleaning up frees enough space to keep working.
  • Fixed charts, tables, and diagrams in artifacts staying blank when offline or when the network blocked the site their libraries came from. The libraries now come with the app.
  • Fixed Cowork tasks on a computer whose administrator turned off the local VM trying to start on that computer instead of in the cloud.
  • Fixed messages that could not be sent sometimes appearing as sent, with no error shown.
  • Fixed scheduled tasks on your computer that could not be edited after their first run ("Failed to update scheduled task").
  • Fixed the first message of a new task being lost when the app reloaded while the task was starting.

3P

  • Added developerModeEnabled, which lets admins turn off Developer Mode and block installing extensions from a folder. It also applies on standard deployments.
  • Added a "Not set" or "Allow none" choice to the empty coworkEgressAllowedHosts and sshHostAllowlist (beta) lists in the Setup window. "Allow none" saves and exports an empty list.
  • Added a configuration warning for a disabledBuiltinTools entry spelled with underscores or hyphens, such as web_fetch; the warning gives the correct name, WebFetch.
  • (breaking) Removed the deprecation notices for the spellings that stopped being accepted on October 7, 2026: header maps written as a string or list, inferenceGatewayAuthScheme: "auto", the ask-session permission value, older managedMcpServers entry forms, and the orgPluginSettings record form. Such a value is now reported like any other invalid value; the replacements are listed under v1.40609.0.
  • (breaking) Removed the former key names enduserAttribution, trustBootstrapLocalExec, and inferenceGatewayHeaders. In a configuration that still uses one, the name is now an unrecognized key: its setting no longer applies and the deprecation notice no longer appears. End-user attribution is then on, except in the Windows registry, where names ignore case and enduserAttribution still reads as endUserAttribution. A bootstrapUrl set by device management (on Windows, machine policy only) is trusted without asking each user. No custom inference headers are sent. Use endUserAttribution, trustBootstrapDelivery, and inferenceCustomHeaders instead. The former extension key names are under General.
  • Changed disabledBuiltinTools: a WebFetch or bare Bash entry added by device management now also applies to Cowork and Chat conversations already open.
  • Changed disableNonessentialServices so that it no longer turns off Chart.js, Grid.js, and Mermaid in artifacts, which now come with the app.
  • Changed managedMcpServers: an entry whose toolPolicy is malformed is no longer dropped. It is kept with that tool, or every tool, blocked, and a configuration error is reported.
  • Changed sshTransport (beta) on every platform: a value that cannot be read, such as a misspelling, now counts as builtin instead of the default engine.
  • Changed OAuth-protected MCP connectors to ask you to sign in again once after this update, and again whenever a connector's URL changes.
  • Changed the Setup window's .reg export to write machine policy (HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE) instead of user policy (HKEY_CURRENT_USER); importing the file now needs administrator rights, and deploying it as user policy means replacing HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE with HKEY_CURRENT_USER first.
  • Changed which hosts the agent's tools reach automatically: your inference provider's, gateway's, and OTLP collector's hosts and api.anthropic.com are no longer added to coworkEgressAllowedHosts for you. List them if your agents' shell commands, web fetches, or http hooks call them.
  • Fixed "Save image" and "Copy image" failing in the Code tab.
  • Fixed a connection delay when Claude started before the configuration server was reachable; Claude now retries when you wake or unlock the computer, or return to the app.
  • Fixed Auto permission mode being greyed out as "Not available for the selected model" in the Code tab for the Claude Haiku model that supports it, which caused new Code sessions to start in Accept edits.
  • Fixed conversations disappearing from the sidebar and not opening when coworkTabEnabled is false. This affected Cowork tasks, including conversations started from the home screen while Unified Claude (beta) was on. They now stay listed and open read-only until Cowork is re-enabled.
  • Fixed Cowork not starting a task when the organization's model list had not loaded. Cowork now waits a short time for the list, then starts the task or shows why it cannot.
  • Fixed file edits in an SSH worktree session on a Linux host sometimes landing in the main checkout or another session's worktree.
  • Fixed MCP connector sign-in failing through explicit OAuth endpoints for identity providers whose issuer has a path.
  • Fixed model pickers showing no Effort control for newer models when modelCatalogEnabled is false; picker names, descriptions, and recommended effort levels now follow the catalog bundled with the app.
  • Fixed scheduled Cowork tasks that never started on a computer where Claude's workspace fails to start; due tasks now start without the workspace after about ten minutes, with commands that need the workspace failing in those runs.
  • Fixed the "Strict sandbox mode" switch under Settings › Claude Code, and the /status card's Sandbox row, showing strict mode as off when your organization's configuration already enforces it.

item.title: v2.31226.1
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.295.

General

  • No user-facing changes.

Code

  • No user-facing changes.

Cowork

  • No user-facing changes.

3P

  • Changed MSIX installs on Windows so that programs started through Git Bash in a session end when the app updates instead of staying open.
  • Fixed every request failing on a 1M-context model when the inference gateway or cloud provider refuses the 1M-context capability; the request is now resent without it.

item.title: v2.31226.0
item.content:encoded:
Bundled Claude Code version: 2.1.293.

General

  • Added skills and local MCP servers to Settings > Import where importing this computer’s third-party history is on: skills saved in Claude (third-party) upload to your own skills automatically, and local MCP servers can be added and started after you confirm the command and settings each one runs with.
